title: Define or reconcile the missing share-only redacted artifact envelope
description:

## Alternatives Considered

1. Add a normative contract section with the exact share envelope and proof obligations.
2. Reconcile AMEND-API-003 to an already-defined exact wire owner.

An unmanifested application value equal to [REDACTED] remains legal. AMEND-API-003 owns the default-equivalence, path-bound, non-mutation, deterministic-output, manifest-consistency, and wrong-kind import-rejection proofs.
